name: MSCST
rootCause: On the BSC network, an unknown smart contract MSCST suffered a flash loan attack, resulting in an estimated loss of approximately $130,000. The root cause of the exploit lies in the lack of access control (ACL) within the releaseReward() function of the MSCST contract, which allowed the attacker to manipulate the price of the GPC token in the PancakeSwap liquidity pool (address: 0x12da).

descriptions.text: On the BSC network, an unknown smart contract MSCST suffered a flash loan attack, resulting in an estimated loss of approximately $130,000. The root cause of the exploit lies in the lack of access control (ACL) within the releaseReward() function of the MSCST contract, which allowed the attacker to manipulate the price of the GPC token in the PancakeSwap liquidity pool (address: 0x12da).

MSCST was exploited on BNB Chain on 2025-12-28, with public records placing the loss at about $129,900. The reported mechanism was a missing access-control check in releaseReward(), which let a flash-loan attacker distort the GPC/WBNB pool price and drain about 149 BNB. A missing access-control check in releaseReward() let an unprivileged caller trigger reward accounting while the GPC/WBNB pool price was being manipulated.
